releaseName: ADC Software 8.5 Standard · Earning Records & PDF Reports
releaseNotes: New: Patient-wise Earning Records with patient name, MR number, procedure(s), receipt and visit dates, discounts and received amounts.
New: Select any date range or use Today, This Month and Last Month for month-end accounting.
New: Download a multi-page PDF report directly, or Print / Save PDF and export CSV.
Improved: Earnings summaries clearly separate total patient collections from operating expenses.
Improved: Classic 8.1-style thermal receipt retained, with a visible Discount and Net Total line on both copies.
Compatibility: Existing 8.1 patient, receipt, doctors and billing data retain their existing local storage structure.
